gaps.title: No common energy-to-velocity saturation ledger for accelerator comparisons
gaps.problem: Public comparisons conflate approaching c with the technologically meaningful performance frontier and often omit the dominant non-kinematic constraint.
gaps.researchable_question: Can a common, source-bounded ledger classify the active constraint without treating speed as an independent high-energy performance metric?

gaps.title: Insufficiently explicit cross-platform sensitivity reporting
gaps.problem: Ring, linear, plasma, and strong-field concepts use different limiting variables, so direct qualitative comparisons can hide parameter assumptions.
gaps.researchable_question: Can model cards and a declared sensitivity matrix separate rigidity, radiation, power/gradient, beam quality, and protection regimes?

gaps.title: Claimed lower-than-c speed ceiling
gaps.problem: A universal finite speed ceiling below c is sometimes inferred from existing machines.
gaps.researchable_question: Not pursued as a discovery claim; it is rejected by the framing of special-relativistic kinematics.
